title: Avoid-list growth tracker for image-to-video take sequences
purpose: Reusable Python function that accepts a chronological list of (take_label, avoid_item_count) pairs, checks monotonicity, reports deltas and regressions, and lists the observations that would falsify a monotone-growth hypothesis. Designed for teams tracking Negative-sentence evolution across takes as described in art_01M67ACYEDW3GH3RZKZRKQF0RN r1.
